verdict.rationale: Superpowers ships built-in automatic triggers (skills auto-trigger on session start/keywords, architectural review triggers after three failed fixes, worktree-removal safeguards trigger on uncommitted work) but these are pre-defined framework behaviors, not a general mechanism for an AI-native user to author their own custom event→action rules. missing for 10: no evidence of a user-facing rule-definition interface/DSL for arbitrary custom triggers, no examples of end-users creating novel event-condition-action rules beyond the shipped skill triggers.
